evals.name: deletes-class-a-restatement
evals.prompt:
/code-tidying:dissolve-comments

(The uncommitted diff contains one code file whose comments restate the adjacent lines: a '// increment counter' above 'counter++;' and a commented-out block of dead code. The file has no other comments.)
expectations: Classifies both comments as class A (zero information) and deletes them outright
Does not modify any non-comment code in the file
Reports per-file counts of applied class-A deletions
Does not commit; leaves the edits in the working tree for review

evals.name: proposes-class-b-without-test-net
evals.prompt:
/code-tidying:dissolve-comments

(The uncommitted diff contains a code file where a comment narrates what a 6-line block does — a class-B extract-function candidate. The repository has no discoverable test command: no test script in the package manifest, no Makefile target, no ecosystem default that resolves.)
expectations: Classifies the block comment as class B with Extract Function as the named move
Does NOT apply the refactoring or delete the comment, because no runnable test net was discovered
Emits the class-B treatment as a proposal in the report
Does not treat the presence of a linter as a substitute for tests

evals.name: safe-mode-applies-removals-only
evals.prompt:
/code-tidying:dissolve-comments safe

(The uncommitted diff contains one file with a class-A restating comment, a class-B magic-literal comment, and the repository has a working test suite.)
expectations: Applies the class-A deletion
Does NOT apply the class-B refactoring even though a test net exists — safe mode restricts applied edits to removals
Emits the class-B item (Replace Magic Literal) as a proposal
Report distinguishes applied removals from proposed refactorings

evals.name: never-touches-exempt-surfaces
evals.prompt:
/code-tidying:dissolve-comments

(The uncommitted diff contains: a public exported function with a JSDoc block, a file-top license header, a line with '// eslint-disable-next-line', a 'TODO(#412): remove after migration' marker, a terse '// items must stay sorted; binary search depends on it' constraint comment, and a change inside .github/workflows/ci.yml.)
expectations: Leaves the public-API JSDoc, license header, lint directive, and TODO(#412) marker untouched
Keeps the sorted-items constraint comment as a class-C keep and says why in the report
Never edits the .github/workflows/ file — excluded path dropped at scoping time
Refuses to reinterpret 'remove comments' as deleting the class-C or exempt material

evals.name: stages-narrative-before-deletion
evals.prompt:
/code-tidying:dissolve-comments

(The uncommitted diff contains a file with a 10-line comment justifying why one caching strategy was chosen over another; one line of it states a durable constraint — the cache must be invalidated before writes.)
expectations: Extracts the durable constraint into a terse one-line class-C comment
Stages the removed justification narrative as a proposed commit-message block in the output before the deletion is final
Does not silently destroy the narrative text
Recommends handing the staged block to /source-control:commit when committing
